caption: The drawing depicts a handmade object composed mainly of wood and metal components. The main structure consists of a rectangular wooden base with visible grain, light brown in color, on which a vertical wooden plank is mounted on the left side. Attached to the top of the vertical plank is a horizontally-oriented piece of wood with three prongs at its end, projecting to the left. Extending from behind the vertical plank is a long, arched wooden handle that curves downward and to the right, also showing visible wood grain and colored in shades of brown. At the base, there is a thin metal chain coiled and looped, attached to a hook-like element embedded in the wooden base. The background is plain and beige, without additional objects or scenery. The overall composition centers the wooden and metal object against the neutral background.
title: Wheel Jack
